title: FIFA WC: Curaçao script history before Germany's seven-goal blitz seals emphatic win

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Billionaire Mark Cuban warns even the wealthiest entrepreneurs face potential fortune loss from stock market crashes. He highlighted his past wealth exceeding Musk and Bezos combined, emphasizing his focus on passion over rankings. Cuban also voiced concerns about wealth concentration and shared his innovative strategy for safeguarding his $1.
title: Mark Cuban warns 'Elons of world' could see wealth wiped out in stock market crash

author: MANVI VYAS
description: A software engineer's life was tragically cut short at a farmhouse party in Yadadri-Bhuvanagiri. Gandla Ramu was discovered lifeless in a swimming pool following an alleged altercation during a team outing. While police have registered a murder case based on the father's complaint, the exact cause of death awaits the post-mortem report.
title: '20 people at party, all drunk': Mystery shrouds Hyderabad techie's death during team farmhouse outing

author: SURENDRA SINGH
description: The Army has also introduced a new winter working dress featuring a Battle Jacket, which will gradually replace the existing jersey-based winter uniform (Dress 3A) by June 2029. The Battle Jacket has been reintroduced as standard winter outerwear for all ranks, with a three-year transition period for implementation. Among the changes is the introduction of a closed-neck coat, commonly known as a Bandi jacket, to be worn over a full-sleeved shirt with matching formal trousers and closed footwear.
title: To remove residual colonial dress customs, Army brings in Bandis, battle jackets

author: RUPALI MUKHERJEE
description: “Every AI breakthrough has a physical backbone — power grids need an upgrade, cooling systems must be built, and factories increasingly need to be automated. Behind every intelligent machine, highly specialised human expertise is required,” Viswanath P S, MD & CEO, Randstad India, said. Terming it as a pronounced “labour flip”, he said skilled, technical trades are outpacing traditional, entry-level professional roles.
title: Skilled blue-collar talent in demand amid AI surge

author: DIPAK K DASH
description: In April 2022, National Green Tribunal (NGT) had ordered the Board to complete mapping of NCZ. Experts working for protection of Aravali and NCZ in NCR said the Board should expedite the process to comply with the tribunal’s order. While UP and Rajasthan have completed the delineation of NCZ after carrying out the ground truthing exercise, Haryana and Delhi are still in the process of finalising this.
title: NCZ restoration puts focus on delayed mapping of Aravali, conservation zones

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Ram Charan's sports drama 'Peddi' is soaring at the box office, crossing Rs 216 crore net in India and nearing Rs 308 crore worldwide. The film saw a significant jump on its eleventh day, with strong occupancy, especially in Telugu states.
title: 'Peddi' collection day 11: Ram Charan film sees 13.6% growth

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Deepti Sharma achieved a career-best 5/10 and became the highest wicket-taker in Women's T20 Internationals. Her bowling masterclass helped India defeat Pakistan by 64 runs in their T20 World Cup opener. Smriti Mandhana and Richa Ghosh powered India to a strong total earlier. India began their campaign with an emphatic win.
title: Deepti Sharma sets world record with historic five-for against Pakistan

author: SANJIB CHAKRABORTY
description: TMC MP Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar's son, Baidyanath, announced he's returning gifts from Mamata Banerjee, including a wedding necklace and a Durga Puja outfit, citing personal conscience and legal action over alleged defamatory statements. He plans to send the items with accrued interest to Banerjee's residence. Senior TMC leaders dismissed his actions as childish and politically motivated.
title: Rebel TMC MP Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar's son says he will return Mamata Banerjee's wedding gifts

author: PARAG DAVE, NIYATI PARIKH, NIMESH KHAKHARIYA
description: Gujarat's exporters are facing a severe crisis due to a dramatic surge in logistics costs and trade uncertainties with West Asia. Freight charges have skyrocketed, and disruptions to traditional shipping routes have increased transit times and expenses. This is impacting various sectors, eroding margins and affecting shipment viability.
title: Sky-high shipping costs squeeze Gujarat trade margins amid Gulf unrest

author: TNN
description: Kerala Chief Minister VD Satheesan strongly criticized three Vice-Chancellors for attending an RSS event, demanding their apology for undermining the state's educational integrity. Opposition leader Pinarayi Vijayan also accused the government and UDF of failing to resist Sangh Parivar influence in higher education, questioning their stance on recent appointments and university affairs.
title: Why Kerala CM VD Satheesan wants 3 vice-chancellors to ‘apologise’ for attending RSS event

description: Congress said India should put off the upcoming visit of US trade representatives in view of the killings of seafarers and Rubio’s “threatening language” with Jaishankar. title: Will Modi take up sailor deaths with Trump, asks Congress

author: TOHID QURESHI
description: For nearly 40 years, he circled the globe building alliances for the idea of India. In the freezing Dec of 1915, amidst the rugged peaks of Kabul, Afghanistan, Barkatullah, alongside revolutionaries Raja Mahendra Pratap and Maulana Ubaidullah, breathed life into India’s first govt-in-exile. Raja Mahendra Pratap was declared President; Mohammad Barkatullah was appointed Prime Minister.
title: Freedom fighter Barkatullah, PM of India’s 1st govt-in-exile, battles erasure

author: TNN
description: Congress has planned a national outreach that will seek to unite students beyond political affiliations and provide a platform for the affected youth to share their experiences and demand accountability for “repeated examination failures and paper leak scandals”. AICC general secretary KC Venugopal said Rahul will also be holding conventions in Allahabad (July 10), Patna (July 11), and Delhi (July 14).
title: NEET leak & jobs: Rahul Gandhi to hold town halls across nation

description: Mandhana scored 68 off 44 balls and shared a 91-run partnership with captain Harmanpreet Kaur (36 off 35 balls) after India were reduced to 18 for 2 early in the innings. Richa Ghosh then added 34 off 17 balls to give India a strong finish.
title: Mandhana scripts history, joins Harmanpreet and Mithali Raj to become ...

author: IP SINGH
description: An Hoshiarpur jail inmate, accused in multiple cases, livestreamed videos from prison alleging drug supply, even displaying what he claimed was methamphetamine. He accused officials of complicity and challenged authorities to reveal names. The incident has sparked outrage, with opposition parties questioning the government's law and order claims and anti-drug campaign.
title: ‘Drugs available’: Murder accused livestreams from Punjab jail; watch
